description: The 2026 field (REBUILT) for on-the-fly paths: centre origin (WPILib 2027), both alliances, metres. From WPILib's 2026-rebuilt-welded AprilTag layout (allwpilib c610ffd17f, fields/src/generate/resources/org/wpilib/fields/apriltag/2026-rebuilt-welded.csv): each hub is the square its tags sit on (x 3.04 to 4.25 from the centre line, y -0.60 to 0.60); the bumps either side of each hub are 1.13 m deep (game manual: 44.4 in) and run from the hub to y +-2.46, where the trench begins; each tower stands at its alliance wall around its tags (y -0.29 and 0.14 on blue, half-turned on red), assumed 0.95 m deep and 1.1 m wide. The bumps are obstacles here (a robot that drives over them can delete them); the trenches are open (a robot under the trench arm's 22.25 in fits), so the routes between the alliance zones and the neutral zone run through them. Approximate: measure the real field before trusting the centimetres.
